page.overview:
Who is Arturo Burelli?

Arturo Burelli was a Physician living in the dark, oppressive city of Mordheim during the downfall of that once-great city in 1999 IC. The city was struck by catastrophe after a twin-tailed comet, which was initially seen as a good omen, crashed into it, bringing chaos, mutation, and horror to its streets.
